meaning.vi: Một loại giấy mỏng, chắc, nhẹ, trong mờ; được sử dụng đặc biệt để tạo bản sao carbon.

sentences.en: An onionskin -like structure of concentric dust shells surround a central, aging star. Twin beams of light radiate from the star and illuminate the usually invisible dust.

sentences.en: Extraction technology of flavones in onionskin was studied by single factor and orthogonal experiment.

sentences.en: I immediately had copies made at great expense because it was typewritten on onionskin paper in the 1940s.

sentences.en: The method of enzyme hydrolysis was used to make onionskin, then the approach of ethanol immersion extraction was used to extract flavonoid compounds of onion.
sentences.vi: Phương pháp thủy phân bằng enzyme được sử dụng để làm vỏ hành tây, sau đó phương pháp chiết xuất ngâm trong etanol được sử dụng để chiết xuất các hợp chất flavonoid của hành tây.

sentences.en: Pathological examination showed desmoplasia among neurofibras and decreased myelinated nerve fibers in 15 patients; and onionskin change in 14 patients.
